description: The graph illustrates the similarity between different layers of a model, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 2, and the y-axis representing similarity values from 0.00 to 0.45. Four distinct lines are plotted: red for en&en, blue for en&es, green for en&el, and purple for en&bn. The red line (en&en) starts at a similarity of approximately 0.10, peaks at around 0.28 at layer 6, then gradually decreases to about 0.12 at layer 18, before sharply increasing to over 0.45 at layer 22. The blue line (en&es) follows a similar trend, starting at about 0.08, peaking at 0.27 at layer 6, decreasing to 0.10 at layer 18, and rising to 0.35 at layer 22. The green line (en&el) begins at 0.06, peaks at 0.18 at layer 6, decreases to 0.08 at layer 18, and rises to 0.30 at layer 22. The purple line (en&bn) starts at 0.05, peaks at 0.17 at layer 6, decreases to 0.07 at layer 18, and rises to 0.32 at layer 22. All lines show a general trend of increasing similarity towards the end of the layers.
